[Unit]
Description=Roostack photos-family: database main (postgres)

[Container]
ContainerName=roostack-photos-family-db-main
Image=ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.4.3-pgvectors0.2.0@sha256:bcf63357191b76a916ae5eb93464d65c07511da41e3bf7a8416db519b40b1c23

Environment=POSTGRES_USER=photos_family
Environment=POSTGRES_DB=photos_family
Environment=POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/db-password
Secret=roostack-photos-family-db-main-password,type=mount,target=db-password
Volume=/srv/roostack/services/photos-family/db/main:/var/lib/postgresql/data
HealthCmd=pg_isready -U photos_family -d photos_family
HealthInterval=10s
HealthStartPeriod=30s
Notify=healthy
Label=io.roostack.service=photos-family
Label=io.roostack.component=db-main
ShmSize=128m

[Service]
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

==> quadlet/roostack-photos-family-server.container
# Generated by Roostack. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=Roostack photos-family: server
Requires=roostack-photos-family-db-main.service
After=roostack-photos-family-db-main.service
Requires=roostack-photos-family-db-cache.service
After=roostack-photos-family-db-cache.service

[Container]
ContainerName=roostack-photos-family-server
Image=ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:v2.1.0@sha256:72a9b9de6c6abfa7a9c9cdc244ae4d2bd9fea2ae00997f194cbd10aca72ea210
Network=roostack-photos-family.network
PublishPort=127.0.0.1:20003:2283
Environment=DB_DATABASE_NAME=photos_family
Environment=DB_HOSTNAME=roostack-photos-family-db-main
Environment=DB_USERNAME=photos_family
Environment=IMMICH_MACHINE_LEARNING_ENABLED=true
Environment=IMMICH_MACHINE_LEARNING_URL=http://roostack-photos-family-machine-learning:3003
Environment=REDIS_HOSTNAME=roostack-photos-family-db-cache
Secret=roostack-photos-family-db-main-password,type=env,target=DB_PASSWORD
Volume=/srv/roostack/media/photos-family/library:/data
Volume=/srv/roostack/media/photos-family/encoded:/data/encoded-video
Volume=/srv/roostack/media/photos-family/thumbs:/data/thumbs
AddDevice=/dev/dri
GroupAdd=keep-groups
Label=io.roostack.service=photos-family
Label=io.roostack.component=server

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

==> caddy/sites/photos-family.caddy
# Generated by Roostack for service "photos-family". Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

@photos-family-web host family-photos.lab.example.com
handle @photos-family-web {
	@photos-family-web-external not remote_ip private_ranges 100.64.0.0/10
	abort @photos-family-web-external
	request_body {
		max_size 50GB
	}
	reverse_proxy 169.254.1.3:20003
}
